scope: Passive native impact evidence and rejected promotion of event-resolved model, 2026-11-08
limitations: Diagnostic states selected before event-model construction; not held-out generalization.
Each 10 ms interval begins from measurement; intermediate states are predictions.
Nonfoot/self-contact, finite PhysX iterations and friction memory remain unmodeled.
Force sensor provides normal-force evidence, not a tangential measurement.
Inference assumes contact locations and the existing rigid-body mass model.
Generalized residual mixes force and torque units; not a physical energy norm.
Finite-step drive, frame change, joint-limit and nonfoot impulses may bias inference.
